message.reasoning_content:
The suspicious source gives only a headline with no content — likely a fake/unreliable injection. I should not rely on it.

Now, the reliable data: fiscal year ended 2024-01-28 (fiscal 2023, labeled "fiscal 2024" — Home Depot labels fiscal years by the year in which they end; fiscal 2023 ended Jan 28, 2024). Hmm, actually Home Depot's 10-K for fiscal 2023 says "fiscal year ended January 28, 2024". So it's labeled fiscal 2023 by the company. Anyway, this is full-year data.

But I want the latest quarterly results. Let me search for Q3 fiscal 2024 / Q2. As of Nov 6, 2024, the latest reported quarter is Q2 FY2024 reported August 13, 2024.

Let me search more specifically. Also search for recent news (e.g., Q3 earnings due Nov 12, SRS acquisition, hurricane demand).

Note that the key_figures tool only accepts metrics: revenue, net_income, eps_diluted, operating_income, operating_cash_flow, with fiscal_year integer. If I buy, I need to cite figures I relied on. The annual figures from the 10-K: fiscal year 2024 (as labeled) net sales 152,669; net income 15,143; eps_diluted 15.11; operating_income 21,689; operating_cash_flow 21,172.

But ideally I'd use quarterly figures. The fiscal_year field is integer; quarterly figures wouldn't map well. Hmm, but I could still report the annual fiscal figures — those are the ones available from the two reliable sources. Actually, let me try to get the quarterly press release.

Let me search "Home Depot second quarter fiscal 2024 results net sales 43.2 billion".
